evidence.note: Agent works through the surface in a mostly systematic order (customers, PMs, PIs, decline, invalid card, state machine, SDK compat, subscriptions/invoices/webhooks/restricted keys), demonstrating awareness of what has and hasn't been exercised, without an explicit checklist artifact.
Discovered a form-parsing gap for subscription items, diagnosed root cause and fixed it in a single pass, then re-ran — no repeated/circular re-debugging of the same case (no thrashing).

Before finalizing, the agent lists remaining edge cases to verify (missing auth, restricted-key permission, deleted resources, list limit/pagination, customer delete shape) and reallocates attention to cover them rather than over-polishing one area.

Final enumeration accurately maps coverage against the full route table and all three trap subsystems (idempotency error replay, webhook retry+re-sign, PI unexpected_state), showing an accurate done-vs-remaining picture at close.

reasoning: The agent maintained an accurate mental picture of coverage across all 12 resource families and the three traps, moved through them without leaving major areas silently unstarted, and showed no circular re-debugging — matching and slightly exceeding the level-5 anchor. It falls short of 8 because tracking was implicit prose rather than an actively maintained checklist against the route table, and it never explicitly time-boxed a stuck behavior (it never got stuck) nor clearly distinguished implemented-only from implemented-and-verified. This places it between the 5 and 8 anchors, at 6.
